title: Phantom Paradoxes: Language Models Treat Unresolved Circular Truth Dependence as Contradiction
abstract: arXiv:2604.12128v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Do language models struggle with self-reference itself, or with structures where propagating truth values along references cannot settle a value in finitely many steps? Our results support the latter. In our main test, statements refer to one another's truth in a cycle, yet exactly one consistent assignment exists. Local propagation never settles the queried value, but exhaustive search finds it, so INCONSISTENT (no consistent assignment) is always wrong. We call such misreadings of satisfiable problems phantom paradoxes. Each circular problem has a grounded twin with the same answer but no cycle. To rule out logical difficulty and unfamiliar wording, we added constraint twins (equivalent formulas without talk of truth) and perplexity-matched grounded controls. In confirmatory behavioral tests fixed before any confirmation response, four open models from three families answered INCONSISTENT on average 31.0 percentage points more ofte

translated_title: 幻影悖论：语言模型将未能解决的循环真值依赖视为矛盾
translated_abstract: 语言模型究竟是在自指本身上存在困难，还是在那些沿引用传播真值无法在有限步骤内确定取值的结构上存在困难？我们的结果支持后者。在我们的主要测试中，语句之间以循环方式相互指涉彼此的真值，但恰好存在唯一一个一致的赋值。局部传播永远无法确定被查询语句的取值，而穷举搜索可以找到它，因此回答 INCONSISTENT（不存在一致赋值）总是错误的。我们将这种对可满足问题的误读称为“幻影悖论”。每个循环问题都有一个答案相同但没有循环的接地孪生问题。为了排除逻辑难度和不熟悉措辞的干扰，我们还构建了约束孪生问题（不含真值谈论的等价公式）以及困惑度匹配的接地对照组。在预先固定的验证性行为测试中，来自三个系列的四个开放模型平均多回答 INCONSISTENT 31.0 个百分点……
tldr: 语言模型会将表面上像悖论、但实际上存在唯一一致真值赋值的循环自指问题误判为“不一致”，这种被称为“幻影悖论”的错误源于无法通过有限步骤传播确定真值的循环结构，而非自指本身。
en_tdlr: Language models misjudge circular self-reference problems that seem paradoxical but actually have a unique consistent truth assignment as inconsistent—a phenomenon termed "phantom paradoxes"—revealing that their difficulty stems from circular structures unsolvable by finite-step propagation rather than self-reference itself.
